{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.dtypes)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print(f'\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age: { (df["customer_age"] == -1).sum() }')

# Check for refunded orders
print(f'\nNumber of refunded orders: { (df["status"] == "refunded").sum() }')

# Check revenue column: is it string? Any malformed values?
print(f'\nUnique revenue values (first 10): {df["revenue"].unique()[:10]}')

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check if all 'completed' orders are included in the population
completed_count = (df['status'] == 'completed').sum()
print(f'\nTotal completed orders: {completed_count}')"}
